name: Crypto 20-Day Trend Breakout
hypothesis: Time-series momentum: fresh 20-day H4 closing breakouts aligned with a sloping 50-day baseline in BTC/ETH continue over the following days.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; 3x H4 ATR(30) stop; 3R objective; 7-day time limit; long-side swap financing included by the evaluator.
known_limitations: No verified edge. Few independent events per year; BTC/ETH highly correlated; long financing (swap mode 5) is material over multi-day holds; weekend liquidity.
